title: Stuff's Custom model Pack
description: A datapack to allow Minecraft servers a survival-friendly way to give players their custom textures/models.
body: This datapack was made to allow Minecraft servers a survival-friendly way to give players their custom textures/models. This datapack was written for Wildcard MC, a survival server based around Hermitcraft TCG, although has been uploaded to modrinth for others to use.
